_comment: All fixed design choices. Nothing here was tuned on SICKLE labels. See PREREGISTRATION.md.

sickle.date_task_filter: YIELD > 0 (as in official train.py for all non crop_type tasks)

bare_soil_model.input_scale: Sentinel-2 L2A surface reflectance x 10000, no BOA offset (identical to SICKLE npz values)
bare_soil_model.binary_threshold_source: default decision threshold of XGBClassifier.predict() for binary:logistic; NOT tuned on SICKLE

cloud_mask.source: Sen2Cor SCL layer delivered with SICKLE
cloud_mask.invalid_scl_meaning: 0 no-data, 1 saturated/defective, 3 cloud shadow, 8 cloud medium prob, 9 cloud high prob, 10 thin cirrus, 11 snow (no snow in Cauvery delta -> treated as cloud)

cv.folds1to4: official-val plots stay in training; official-train plots partitioned into 4 plot-disjoint groups (seeded, seed=2024)
cv.inner_validation: 15% of training plots (seeded) held out for early stopping

success_criterion.test: two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank on plot-level mean absolute-error differences (B - C)
